content.title: Privacy Policy

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.content: When you create an account, place an order, or contact support, we collect information such as your name, email address, phone number, delivery address, and order history. We use this information solely to operate the store — processing orders, providing support, and improving the shopping experience.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.content: Your information is used to fulfill orders, communicate order updates, respond to support requests, and — with your consent — send occasional offers and newsletters. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: Data storage and security
sections.content: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. No online service can guarantee absolute security, so we encourage using a strong, unique password for your account.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.content: You can review and update your account details at any time from My Account, and you may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting support.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.content: Questions about this policy can be sent to our support email at support@daalbhat.com.

content.disclaimer: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.

sections.heading: Packaged & non-perishable items
sections.content: Unopened packaged goods (pantry staples, personal care, household items) can be returned within 7 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange. Please keep the original packaging where possible.

sections.heading: Fresh produce & perishables
sections.content: Dairy and other perishables are covered by our freshness guarantee instead of the standard return window — if something arrives damaged or below quality, contact us within 24 hours of delivery with a photo, and we'll issue a replacement or refund right away.

sections.heading: How to request a return
sections.content: Reach out via the Contact page or your Order History with your order number and a brief description of the issue. Most requests are resolved within 1–2 business days.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.content: Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method (or as store credit for Cash on Delivery orders) within 5–7 business days of approval.

sections.heading: Non-returnable items
sections.content: For hygiene reasons, opened personal care and baby care items cannot be returned unless defective on arrival.

sections.heading: Delivery options
sections.content: Standard Delivery takes 2 to 3 days and is free on orders over $700 ($49 flat rate otherwise). Express Delivery is available next day at a $99 flat rate.

sections.heading: Delivery areas
sections.content: We currently deliver within our serviceable pin codes, shown automatically at checkout based on your address. If we don't yet deliver to your area, you'll see a message at checkout before placing your order.

sections.heading: Order tracking
sections.content: Once your order is confirmed, you can track its status anytime from My Account → Order History.

sections.heading: Missed deliveries
sections.content: If you're unavailable at the time of delivery, our courier will attempt to contact you and reschedule. Orders that can't be delivered after repeated attempts may be returned to us and refunded, minus any delivery fee already incurred.

sections.heading: Using our site
sections.content: By creating an account or placing an order, you agree to provide accurate information and to use the site only for lawful purposes. We may suspend or close accounts used for fraudulent or abusive activity.

sections.heading: Orders and pricing
sections.content: All prices are listed in US Dollars ($) and include applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. We reserve the right to correct pricing errors and to cancel orders affected by such errors, with a full refund if payment was already made.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.content: Delivery estimates are shown at checkout and are our best estimate, not a guarantee. Delays due to weather, regional restrictions, or circumstances beyond our control may occasionally occur.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.content: DaalBhat is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the site, to the fullest extent permitted by law. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot legally be excluded.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.content: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the site after a change constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
